narration: 北海道によるクマの問題行動の分類によると、このクマは最も有害性が高い「段階3」と認定されました。
asset_type: キャラアニメーション
scene: 対策本部の机の前で、道の職員（039と同じ灰色のスーツの50代男性）が分類資料の「段階3」を指し、深刻な顔で告げる。

fences.text: A municipal bear-response headquarters desk in Setana, southwestern Hokkaido, in late April spring: stacks of plain case files, a folded map, and pinned on the board behind the desk a large printed telephoto photograph of an adult male Hokkaido brown bear about 2 metres long and roughly 150 to 250 kilograms, ON ALL FOURS, head dropped low, jaws open in a savage snarl with long fangs bared, ears pinned flat, the fur along its neck bristled up into a raised ridge.
